findings.description: This PR edits the body of decision 179, which has already landed. `docs/adr/README.md` says a landed decision gets a dated amendment section, or a new decision that links back with `Amends:`, instead of a rewrite of its text.

The new sentence in `typeHold`'s JSDoc, and the test comment at `cache-hold.test.ts:192-193`, repeat the reason `runsSessionLaunch`'s JSDoc already gives: a restarted server reissues pane ids. The AGENTS.md comments rule says to delete call-site copies of the callee's reason. Keep only the fact that nothing is read or typed unless the check passes.

This PR guards only the cache hold. After a tmux server restart, the recorded `%N` pane id can still name an unrelated pane, and other code acts on it unchecked. `killSession` kills by pane id after a merge, on `pup kill` and on `pup kill --respawn`, so it can kill an operator's whole tmux session. `steerPane` can type a gate report, a peer message or a watchdog resume into an unrelated Claude Code pane. `fix-round` already kills by name for this reason. `runsSessionLaunch` could guard these paths too.
